# Purpose

This script analyzes student grades and calculates summary statistics.

# Inputs

- grades.csv

# Outputs

- Mean grade
- Summary statistics

# Required Packages

```r
library(tidyverse)
```

# Example Code

```r
grades <- read.csv("grades.csv")
mean(grades$Grade)
```

# Notes

This script is intended for educational purposes.
